description: v0.43 双 token 形成终点的独立伙伴替换与协议兼容性
research_question: 角色对称化形成的协议能否被另一个独立形成的 agent 直接读懂；一个或全部 sender 被替换时，兼容性如何随角色模式、伙伴拓扑和资源排列变化？

transfer.replacement_definition: slot0/1/2 replaces the sender at that team position after the evaluated role permutation; all replaces all three senders
transfer.donor_pool: another v0.43 endpoint culture with the same seed, partition and resource-column assignment
transfer.visual_frontends: same frozen private frontends within a visual group
transfer.communication: two tokens per resource sender, vocabulary 7

measures.native_control: none replacement must reproduce the sealed v0.43 endpoint score for every recipient culture, schedule, role permutation and team
measures.interpretation: compatibility is direct endpoint reading, not post-replacement learning or open-ended language

hypotheses: Independent communication conventions will be poorly compatible even when each culture succeeds natively.
Formation with random role order will reduce cross-culture replacement loss and make replacement-slot effects more uniform.
Replacing all senders will reduce function more than replacing one sender, while token agreement will predict residual function.
controls_and_limits: No new parameters are trained; all transfer results are endpoint inference from v0.43 final states.
Keeping seed, partition and resource assignment fixed isolates communication compatibility from visual-front-end mismatch, but does not test new agents with new perception.
The task remains finite six-site grounded coordination with a two-token message and centralized reward inherited from v0.43.
Role-equivalent scores synchronize target axes and should be read together with literal scores.
